name: less
purpose: Interactive terminal pager for scrolling forward and backward through large files.
explanation: Opens a file or piped stream one screen at a time without loading the entire file into RAM or dumping thousands of lines onto your terminal.

parameters.description: Searches forward for `pattern` inside the pager (`n` jumps to next match).
Quits `less` and returns to the shell prompt.

expectedOutput: (Opens interactive full-screen pager showing the first lines of `/var/log/syslog`; press `q` to exit)
whenToUse: When inspecting multi-megabyte log files or long outputs where `cat` would flood the terminal.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to press `q` to exit `less` (the terminal appears 'stuck' until you quit).
explanationOfOutput: Displays one viewport of text at a time with keyboard navigation (`Space`, `b`, `/`, `q`).
